prompt: Render a high-fidelity 1440×900 landscape desktop app screen for Lucyna, edge to edge, crisp Simplified Chinese text, no browser, physical device or perspective. It is an operational AI workspace, with real standard buttons, tabs, inputs and an editable message composer. Users pick a Work and continue an OMP conversation with files and evidence at hand. Selected Work “lucyna”, other Works “docs-site” and “design-system”. Active conversation “整理知识库阅读体验”. Navigation 工作台, 知识库, 会话, plus 搜索工作, 新会话, 设置. Show one user message “继续一下刚才的工作，先确认当前知识库的阅读体验。” and a clear assistant answer headed “工作上下文已经整理好了。” with short bullets about Work, knowledge and retained OMP sessions. Standard composer with 发送. Inspector tabs 工作, 文件, 终端, 记忆, containing 当前目标, 下一步 and 上下文来源. Show WSL OMP 已连接 as demo state. Preserve the reference's silver-haired Lucyna girl and black cat in a modest visible companion spot, while the conversation remains primary. No invented performance metrics, marketing claims or decorative charts. Every region must read as a polished app you can operate. Visual direction: clear editorial desk. White and very pale cool blue are the reading grounds; deep ink text and one precise cobalt selection color give hierarchy. Use a horizontal primary navigation above a compact Work directory, a broad conversation canvas and quiet evidence margin. Larger clear contextual title, precise body sans, spacious well-aligned columns and restrained rules. A useful evidence-margin rhythm aligns citations to conversation sections as the one signature. The result must feel luminous, authored and extraordinarily refined rather than bare gray. The character reference supplies identity only; never copy its background or enlarge into a hero.
